conversion: Original checkpoint graph, positions, prefab trigger bounds and spawn preserved. Empty builtin mesh bounds are recovered from the exported source geometry. Source Start is folded into Finish once per lap; our countdown begins at spawn. Gate normal sign follows the ordered route. Authored track props must be imported before activation.

checkpointRespawns.rule: Blocked derived reset positions are moved to a verified legal aperture point 0.5 metres beyond the source portal. Gate geometry/order remain unchanged.
